reviews.title: Affordable Performance
reviews.comment:
This is a terrific heatsink/fan combination that is well made and highly affordable.  A y-splitter cable is provided to combine the 2x 4 pin PWM connectors into a single 4pin PWN mobo header.
The fan even comes with a large tube of Thermalright TF7 paste which is quality paste.
This product was purchased for a stock 12700kf, no undervolt or overclock, just stock with intel pref settings (none of that MCE stuff) inside of a H9 Flow case (2025) and there's no issue with noise or sound; keeps the CPU in the low to mid 60's with small bursts to 71c at 70% power in Cyberpunk 2077 with all Raytracing settings maxxed.
One thing worth mentioning, if you have large RAM heatsinks, you will need to get creative. If you have low profile ram, you should be fine.
Overall, this is a great product with easy installation and quality performance that would rival AIO's.
reviews.author: Daniel Krause

reviews.title: Works suprisingly well and is super affordable!
reviews.comment:
I bought this to replace a 240 mm water cooler that was giving me issues. This is very much a budget cooler with good performance. After applying the correct amount of thermal paste, repositioning the fans in my case to blow air out the top and front, I am idling between 37-40 c. It does great at idle and during light loads, loading up some 4k high on Battlefield 6, and it hits as high as 73c on an AMD 9700X. I don't think you can ask more of a sub $40 cooler.
UPDATE: I just swapped out the stock fans with three, that's right three, Noctua Redux 120mm fans and idle temps have dropped by 2-3 degrees (35c at idle)! The Noctua fans spin 200 rpm faster at peak and push about 10 more CFM and are quieter. I think performance and value with this setup is a better cooler for your dollar than Noctua's own flagships. If you have some cheap, fast and reasonable pushy fans lying around you can easily improve this HSF already good performance for great performance.
reviews.author: Garrett G. Graham

reviews.title: Excellent cooling, very high quality radiator and fans. Well earned reputation.
reviews.comment:
I constantly saw this cooler recommended as the best basic air cooler around. I have to say, it's very well earned as this is an excellent cooler. The package includes a nice set of brackets and standoffs for both AMD and Intel CPUs. A good thermal paste TF7 is also included which I used.
Setup was pretty easy, it was a little finicky to seat the two main screws that hold the plate to the CPU. I had to watch a short video to figure out how to attach the metal wires to the fans and then stretch them over the radiator.
One thing to note is that the front fan might not fit if your RAM is on the taller side. I had to move the front fan up a few notches which was pretty easy.
Performance seems amazing, even under load the fans are quiet and my Ryzen CPU doesn't even break a sweat. It seems AIOs are popular now but I wanted something as simple as possible with good performance and I'm really pleased with this.
reviews.author: zo

reviews.title: Keeps my CPU cool!!!
reviews.comment: This fan works great and it was straight forward to install. My original CPU fan would start to spin at a very high RPM when playing video games and had poor cooling performance. This new CPU cooler is extremely quit even when playing videos games and keeps the CPU's temperature cool and stable. The only issue I had with it was that I could not fit both fans on the towers because my ram was sitting to tall. So I installed one fan in the middle of the coolers towers which work perfectly.
reviews.author: Glyn

reviews.title: Everything you need
reviews.comment:
This thing is awesome. I was previously using a Noctua NH-U12S, but I upgraded my CPU and these newer Ryzen chips are known to run pretty hot so I needed to reconsider my cooling. The Noctua was nice and silent, but it was only a single tower cooler. I installed this bad boy and saw a significant drop in temps under load, and it's still relatively quiet. I will say that if you're not using low profile RAM, like really low profile, the front fan on this will stick out a bit further than the back one. That doesn't bother me too much though and I doubt it has an effect on cooling performance. It's worth noting that the box includes everything you'll need like mounting brackets, standoffs, thermal paste, daisy chain cable, etc.
Certainly worth picking this up if you're in the market for a solid CPU cooler with incredible value. Thermalright knocked it out of the park!
